validation_winner.rule: Lowest validation MAE among all candidates before evaluating test set
validation_winner.deployment_rationale: A project-level historical median feature does not exist for newly onboarded teams or projects in production.

random_baseline.explanation: 4.7425 is the exact mathematical expected value of drawing from the empirical training distribution against all test labels; 4.7680 was an empirical single-seed draw in the earlier script.

hyperparameters_grid.tuned_on: Validation Set strictly (no test set leakage)
